snippet.title: The Axis Unseen - Release Month Trailer
snippet.description:
The Axis Unseen is a heavy metal horror game where you hunt monsters from folklore. It releases in October 2024. It is created by Nate Purkeypile, a solo indie developer who previously worked for 17 years in AAA on games like Skyrim and Fallout.

Wishlist The Axis Unseen on Steam!
